description.value: Deadwood Junction is a beloved small-town coffee shop and café in Greenwood, BC, founded in 2009 and positioned right off Highway 3 — one of British Columbia's premier cycling corridors through the Kootenays. The shop serves fair trade specialty coffee, house-made sandwiches, and an impressive roster of fresh baked goods, while also hosting Jalapeno Junction, an in-house authentic Mexican food counter. It doubles as a showcase for local antiques and artisan work, offering touring cyclists a genuine taste of small-town southern BC.
